gamerule.interactive_enchanted_books.cra: Combining an enchanted item with a book crafts an Enchantment Echo with the enchantments of the item
gamerule.interactive_enchanted_books.hop: Enables interactions between hoppers and lecterns
gamerule.interactive_enchanted_books.sig: Sending a redstone pulse to a lectern increments the active page. Page changes no longer output redstone pulses
gui.interactive_enchanted_books.unable_t: An error occurred while getting the internal enchantment Identifier
gui.interactive_enchanted_books.particle: Place at least one in bookshelf
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: Removes the mining speed penalty when mining while standing underwater. Does not apply when swimming
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Increases damage dealt to spiders by {damage} hearts and applies up to {maxDuration} seconds of slowness IV
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Once equipped, the user cannot manually remove this item from any armor slot. The item is dropped upon death
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Reduces damage of explosions by {reduction}% and knockback by {knockback}%
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc.level-: Reduces opponents armor effectiveness and toughness by {reduction}%
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc.le: Summons lightning bolts when thrown during thunderstorms. Deals additional damage
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc.level: Increases damage by {damage} hearts per block fallen
enchantment.minecraft.depth_strider.desc: Increases movement speed while walking underwater by {speed}%
enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.desc.le: Increases mining efficiency by {speed} (defaults: Iron 6, Diamond 8)
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc.l: Sets the target on fire for {duration} seconds
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces burn time by {duration}% and damage by {damage}%
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Sets the target on fire for 5 seconds
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc.level: Increases the drop quantity of some blocks mined by an average of {increase}%
Gain immunity to damage from magma blocks and campfires. Converts a {radius} blocks radius of water into ice when walking above water
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc.leve: Increases damage dealt to aquatic mobs by {damage} hearts
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Firing does not consume arrows. Still requires one arrow in the inventory to fire. Fired arrows cannot be picked up
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc.level: Increases the maximum quantity of mob drops by {level}. Increases the chance for rare loot by {increase}%
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc.level: Returns to the player after being thrown with a speed of {speed} blocks per second
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Increases chance of fishing treasure by {treasure}%. Reduces the chance of fishing junk by {junk}%
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc.level-x: The player is launched forward with a speed of {distance} blocks per second. Lunging applies {exhaustion} hunger exhaustion to self
enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc.level-x: Reduces the wait time for a bite by {duration} seconds
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: If the item is in the main hand, offhand or an armor slot and the player gains xp, the item is repaired slightly
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc.lev: Increases projectile count by {quantity} and horizontal projectile spread by {spread}°
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc.leve: The projectile passes through up to {quantity} mobs
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces damage taken from projectiles by {reduction}%
enchantment.minecraft.protection.desc.le: Reduces damage taken from most sources by {reduction}%
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc.level-x: Increases knockback dealt to targets by {knockback} blocks
Reduces the reload time by {duration} seconds
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc.l: Increases time until taking drowning damage by {duration} seconds. Each second has a {chance}% of not taking drowning damage
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc.level: When in water or rain, the player moves with the trident when thrown. Launches the user by a total of {distance} blocks
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Allows collecting fragile versions of blocks like grass, stone or glass
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc.level-x: Increases damage dealt to undead mobs by {damage} hearts
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc.le: Increases movement speed by {speed}% when on soul blocks. Also consumes durability
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Increases damage dealt from sweeping attacks by {increase}%
enchantment.minecraft.swift_sneak.desc.l: Increases crouched movement speed to {increase}% of regular walking speed
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc.level-: Adds a chance of {chance}% that attackers are damaged for up to {maxDamage} hearts
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc.le: Adds a {chance}% chance to not use durability
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: If the player who has this item in their inventory dies, the item is destroyed
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc.le: After performing a smash attack, the player is launched upwards by {distance} blocks
